title: The naive cotangent complex does not depend on the chosen presentation
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement asserts that the complex attached to a presentation of a sheaf of algebras is canonically independent, up to canonical quasi-isomorphism, of the presentation chosen (author lemma at source lines 5942-5946, label lemma-NL-up-to-qis). The proof (source lines 5948-5975) reduces to comparing the complexes of two arbitrary presentations by amalgamating them into a common presentation, produces the comparison maps, and checks that they are quasi-isomorphisms on stalks, where the statement is the corresponding algebraic one; the set-up paragraph defining the complex is reproduced as a context span. The amalgamation of presentations and the reduction to stalks are the content. H2.
